family.description: This is a presumed domain found at the C-terminal of Zinc finger SWIM domain-containing proteins 1 and 3. The function of ZSWIM3 is currently unknown. ZSWIM1 may play a role in the development or function of T helper cells [[cite:PUB00091075]]. According to AlphaFold structure prediction, this domain may consist of two helices.
family.name: Zinc finger SWIM domain-containing protein 1/3, C-terminal
